name: Purpose In Life
overview: Scripture reveals that our purpose in life is fundamentally connected to knowing God, being at peace with Him, and trusting in His sovereign work on our behalf. From God's intimate knowledge and ordaining of us before birth, as seen in Jeremiah 1:5, to the call to fear God and keep His commandments as the whole duty of man in Ecclesiastes 12:13, the Bible directs believers to align their lives with God's perfect plan. Though God's purposes may unfold in His appointed time, Habakkuk 2:3 encourages patient faithfulness, while Psalms 138:8 assures that the Lord will complete what concerns each of us, sustaining His work in our lives.
